turns.text: Hey! Yes, I'm feeling 100% back to normal, thank goodness. Today has been busy but good. I actually had a super relaxed morning for once. I just made a simple mug of filtered drip coffee at home instead of messing with my roommate's fancy new espresso machine.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds nice and low-key. Did you get to enjoy it before heading out, or did you drink it on your way?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I drank most of it while getting ready, and then I hopped on the light rail to head into work. It was a pretty smooth commute today.

turns.text: I did! I put on a podcast that covers current health news and medical updates. It's nice to keep up with what's happening in the broader medical world on my way to the clinic.

turns.text: It's been steady. Lots of routine check-ups and a couple of dressing changes. I just finished my lunch break a little while ago. I was sensible today and packed up some leftovers from last night's dinner to bring with me.

turns.text: Nice! Packing your own lunch is always a great time-saver. Did you make something delicious last night?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, Tom and I made some chicken fajitas last night, so they made for a great lunch today. He actually helped me prep them.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds delicious! It's always great when you can stretch a meal into a second day. Are you and Tom planning any more cooking or baking this week? Maybe some sourdough?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Actually, I have a loaf of sourdough proofing in the fridge right now! I'm planning to bake it tomorrow morning. Hopefully, it turns out well.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: I'm sure it will! There's nothing quite like fresh sourdough. Do you have any plans for salsa dancing later this week, or is it a quiet one?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We're actually planning to go dancing this Friday night! It's been a couple of weeks, so I'm really looking forward to it.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a wonderful way to kick off the weekend. I hope you have a great rest of your shift today!

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks! Just a few more hours and then I can head home. Talk to you tomorrow!
